children.text: The Singapore tourist visa is issued to citizens who wish to visit Singapore for tourism, leisure, visiting friends or relatives, or a short-term business visit.
Georgian citizens obtain their Singapore visa at the consulates in Ankara and Istanbul, Turkey. To apply, the following steps must be completed:

🔹 Gathering the required documents and completing the questionnaire.
🔹 Completing the online application form and uploading the documents.
🔹 Receiving the Payment Request by email.
🔹 Receiving the decision.
🔹 Printing the visa.

page.title: How do I apply for a tourist visa?

children.text:
🔹 A detailed list of documents tailored to your travel purpose.
🔹 Completion of the application form.
🔹 Professional review of the documentation you provide.
🔹 Phone and online support.
🔹 The highest standard of personal data protection.
The decision arrives within 3 to 6 days, by email. You can check the visa's authenticity via
this link
. However, it's recommended to start the process 30 days in advance.
The Singapore tourist visa is a single-entry visa, issued for up to 30 days.

page.title: How long is the visa valid?

children.text: Visa application form
A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Hotel reservation
Flight reservation (round trip)
Color photo
In some cases, additional documents may be required to support the application.
It is possible to extend the visa period while in the country.
The visa allows you to enter Singapore, but does not allow you to remain in the country without a break beyond its validity period.
The approved e-visa is sent to the email address provided when submitting the form (make sure your email address is entered correctly to avoid delays in receiving your visa due to a minor error).
Please note that upon entering Singapore, the passport control officer has the right to request proof of onward/return travel (a return ticket) and may deny entry if this is not provided.
Please note that this information is not exhaustive. For detailed and up-to-date information, please visit the official website of the relevant embassy.

content.text: What are my chances of getting a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your close ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: Does the eConsul guarantee the visa?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa. This decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.
